title: Taskboard Widget MVP Progress Report
exec_summary: Built a local React+TypeScript Element widget MVP saved under /home/kojiyah/taskboard-widget-mvp. Widget reads/writes TaskState to /tmp/taskboard-mvp.json and supports viewing/editing tasks, proposed actions, and Approve/Deny/Defer. No production integrations performed.
architecture_recommendation: Host widget as iframe in Element pointing at the server (http://<host>:3000). Use matrix-widget-api in future to send matrix-signed events; authoritative TaskState should move to Kafka compacted topic later.
first_implementation_milestone: Run server: npm run build && npm start. Open Element room and add widget iframe at http://<host>:3000. Verify task list loads and Approve updates /tmp/taskboard-mvp.json.
next_engineering_tasks: Add matrix-widget-api sendEvent integration so approver-signed Matrix events are used
Replace /tmp persistence with Kafka compacted state topic and event stream
Add E2EE strategy if needed and operational monitoring
short_message: Taskboard MVP built (local). Server and README included. /tmp/taskboard-mvp.json holds sample tasks.
